name: get_drug_side_effects
description: Fetch known side effects of a specified drug by its name. Use this tool when you need to obtain information about the adverse effects associated with a particular medication. Do NOT use this tool for off-label uses or to obtain information about drug interactions; for that, consider using 'get_drug_interactions'.

parameters.name: drug_name
parameters.description: The name of the drug for which to retrieve side effects. Must be a valid drug name as recognized in medical databases. Should not include dosage forms or additional descriptors.

parameters.name: include_common_side_effects
parameters.description: Whether to include common side effects in the response. Set to true to receive a comprehensive list including common effects. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: include_rare_side_effects
parameters.description: Whether to include rare side effects in the response. Set to true to receive a complete list including rare effects. Defaults to false.

drug_name.description: The name of the drug (echoes input).

common_side_effects.description: List of common side effects associated with the drug, if requested.

rare_side_effects.description: List of rare side effects associated with the drug, if requested.

return_schema.description: Object containing the drug name and lists of common and rare side effects based on user preferences.
